Disk usage hit 95% at 05:17:46 (#372) with WAL/binlog growing ~688MB/h, then 99% at 05:21:56 (#687) with growth accelerating to 815MB/h. ingest-api began failing inserts with 'table is full' (error 1114) at 05:23:29 (#794), and events-db logged InnoDB 'Write to file ./events.ibd failed: No space left on device' (#815, #893). The logs don't show what drove the WAL/binlog growth (no purge or retention event appears), so the 'why it grew' is still open.
